title: Brand-neutral image candidates (non-destructive review index)
important_note: This index filters out standalone wordmark/app-store badge files only. It does not edit or erase logos, watermarks, trademarks, text, or brand marks embedded in photographs or banners. Embedded branding and usage rights still require visual review and permission/licence verification before publication.
selection_rules: Exclude standalone filename download.svg (rendered MARKETPLACE wordmark).
Exclude standalone app-playstore.png and app-applestore.png badges.
Preserve banners and generic campaign backgrounds.
Preserve all other image/vector assets as candidates, not as copyright-cleared assets.
